info.title: Sanpu Tour Ops ERP API
info.description: Portfolio prototype by Divakar. All data is fictional demo data. Errors use RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a stable `code` and `correlationId`. Get a token from POST /api/v1/auth/login, then click Authorize and paste it (without the word Bearer).
